description: This bar chart illustrates the difference in average Word Error Rate (WER) from Whisper large for different models, specifically NESCAC ft model and SESHA ft model. The horizontal axis represents the model name, with categories including “Dates”, “Americanisms”, “Optimisations”, “Remove Spacing”, “Add Spacing”, and “Normalised”, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Difference in Average WER from Whisper large”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to 0.0035, with tick labels at intervals of 0.0005.  There are two bars for each model name; a lighter brown bar representing the NESCAC ft model and a darker brown bar representing the SESHA ft model. For “Dates”, the NESCAC ft model bar extends to approximately 0.00228, while the SESHA ft model bar reaches 0.00257.  The bars generally increase in length as the model names progress down the horizontal axis, with the NESCAC ft model bar for “Normalised” reaching approximately 0.00323 and the SESHA ft model bar reaching 0.00334. No bars are visually emphasized or annotated.
